name: mdeditdiff
description: Free, open-source tool: an editor for people, a diff for agents. See what changed in a Markdown file since you last looked, and who changed it. CLI and MCP server for AI agents, plus a native macOS app, sharing one local change history.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run bundle && node --test dist/test/*.test.js
scripts.bundle: esbuild src/diff.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=MDDiff --target=es2020 --outfile=app/Sources/MDEditDiffApp/Resources/Preview/mdeditdiff-diff.js --banner:js="// Generated from tools/mdeditdiff/src/diff.ts by 'npm run bundle'. Do not edit."

author: Vinay Roy
